row.evidence: Rancher's docs list SAML/OIDC auth providers (Okta, Entra ID, Keycloak, PingIdentity, Shibboleth, generic OIDC) but no SCIM; SCIM 2.0 exists only in Rancher's source code as an experimental 'scim' feature flag, which main-branch code is turning into a Prime-only feature.
row.notes: New row. Rancher Manager is open source and self-hosted (free); Rancher Prime is SUSE's paid subscription built from the same code, priced only through a request-pricing form. External authentication (AD, LDAP, Entra ID, Okta SAML, Keycloak, Ping, Shibboleth, AD FS, generic OIDC) is in the open-source product; users are created when they first log in (JIT) and groups come from the IdP. No SCIM in the docs (ranchermanager.docs.rancher.com v2.11 to v2.16 sitemap, SUSE Rancher docs sitemap, feature-flags page). Rancher's GitHub source has an 'Add Experimental SCIM Support' package (SCIM 2.0 under /v1-scim/{provider}/, bearer token from Kubernetes secrets, Users and Groups) behind a 'scim' feature flag that is off by default in v2.14+ releases; on main it is now declared with newPrimeFeature, suggesting a Prime-only gate in a future release. Undocumented, so status is unknown; likely gated (Prime) or free (community flag) once documented. User API: Kubernetes-style users.management.cattle.io resource (create, list, get, delete) and the v3 API, available in open source.

scim.base_url: /v1-scim/{provider}/ on the Rancher server (from source code)

endpoints.notes: Source code lists User and Group resources; not documented.

operations.notes: Source package doc lists user list/get/create/update/delete and group list/get/create/PATCH/delete; left null because it is not in public docs.

limitations.text: Experimental and behind the 'scim' feature flag (default off) in released v2.15.2 code; main branch declares it a Prime feature.

scim.notes: available left null: SCIM exists in Rancher's source code but not in any product documentation or release notes.

auth.notes: Kubernetes API access to the Rancher management cluster or Rancher API tokens.

capabilities.notes: Documented as kubectl operations on the users.management.cattle.io custom resource (Kubernetes REST API); group membership comes from the external IdP and can be refreshed via GroupMembershipRefreshRequest.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/rancher/ and /suse-rancher/ return 404; Rancher documents Okta SAML as an auth provider.

entra.notes: learn.microsoft.com rancher-tutorial returns 404; Rancher documents Entra ID as an auth provider.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud article covers SAML SSO setup for Rancher; no SCIM provisioning described.

fallbacks.other_sync: Group membership pulled from the external IdP at login (AD, LDAP, SAML, OIDC providers)
